hints.title: Core Insight
hints.text: Track only the frequencies of the 26 lowercase characters rather than expanding the actual string.

hints.title: Algorithmic Structure
hints.text: Each transformation shifts frequencies from index c to c+1, while character 25 wraps around to both index 0 and index 1.

hints.title: State Transitions
hints.text: Repeat this transition t times modulo 10^9+7 and sum all final frequencies.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def lengthAfterTransformations(self, s: str, t: int) -> int:
        MOD = 1_000_000_007
        cnt = [0] * 26
        for ch in s:
            cnt[ord(ch) - ord('a')] += 1
            
        for _ in range(t):
            next_cnt = [0] * 26
            for i in range(25):
                next_cnt[i + 1] = cnt[i]
            z = cnt[25]
            next_cnt[0] = (next_cnt[0] + z) % MOD
            next_cnt[1] = (next_cnt[1] + z) % MOD
            cnt = next_cnt
            
        return sum(cnt) % MOD
```

complexity.notes: Evaluates in optimal O(26 * t + n) runtime.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute-force exhaustive search exceeds the time limit.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Uses O(1) auxiliary memory for optimal state tracking.
